items.detail: Live Nov-13 expiry ATM implied volatility of 33.9% sits about 11 points above 20-day realized volatility of 22.7%. items.detail: MSFT (Oct 28), TSLA (Oct 21), and AAPL (Nov 2) all report before the Nov-13 expiry, so their elevated implied volatilities partly reflect the pending print rather than harvestable premium. TSLA's implied move is 7.33% versus a 3.10% ex-outlier historical mean; MSFT's is 6.17% versus 5.61% ex-outlier. TSLA's consensus is disputed — Nasdaq $0.21 (10 estimates) versus Yahoo average $0.45 — so no beat-or-miss call is reliable. MSFT consensus is consistent at $4.71 versus $4.72.

items.detail: FRED via the repo rates module, as of Oct 13: effective fed funds 3.88%, 2Y 4.79%, 10Y 5.21%, 2s10s +42bp. items.detail: The IEA says the global diesel/gasoil balance will stay tight well into 2027, with record September diesel margins near $95 per barrel.
